topic: Integer Overflow Detection and Safe Arithmetic in C++
explanation: In C++, integer overflow occurs when an arithmetic operation exceeds the maximum or minimum value representable by the integer type, leading to undefined behavior or wrap-around. Modern C++ practices emphasize detecting potential overflows to ensure program correctness and safety. Techniques include using compiler built-ins, safe libraries, or explicit checks before performing operations. Proper handling of overflow is crucial in applications requiring robust numerical computations, security, or correctness guarantees.
keywords: Integer overflow C++, Safe arithmetic, Overflow detection, Signed integer UB
